title: Xiaomi Launches Mijia Pocket Photo Printer Pro Gift Box
excerpt: Xiaomi has released the Mijia Pocket Photo Printer Pro Gift Box in China, featuring 313 DPI printing and AR video support.
body_html:
Xiaomi has introduced the Mijia Pocket Photo Printer Pro Gift Box in China, priced at approximately $119.

The newly launched bundle features a pocket photo printer capable of producing 313 DPI prints. Additionally, the device supports augmented reality (AR) videos, allowing users to bring printed photos to life through digital content.

The product is currently available as a gift box bundle in the Chinese market.
